firm_data.firm_description: Kramer Levin provides proactive, creative and pragmatic solutions that address today’s most challenging legal issues. The firm is headquartered in New York with offices in Silicon Valley and Washington, DC, and fosters a strong culture of involvement in public and community service.
notable_facts: The firm has offices in New York, Silicon Valley, and Washington, D.C.
The firm is led by co-managing partners Paul H. Schoeman and Howard T. Spilko.
Paul J. Andre serves as office managing partner of the Silicon Valley office.

tech_contact.name: Joseph J. Palmeri
tech_contact.title: Managing Director, Chief Information and Infrastructure Officer

email.to_title: Managing Director, Chief Information and Infrastructure Officer
email.subject: AI for Kramer Levin, built for firms across three coasts
email.body:
Hi Joseph,

Managing infrastructure and operations across New York, Silicon Valley, and Washington, D.C. offices requires tools that scale without compromise. That's exactly what we're hearing from firms handling complex litigation and restructuring work.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in LA to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office on Thursday, April 10 to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
